essence: Nighttime recitation on a bed with betel in the mouth is specified as a hundred-thousandfold practice.
Nighttime performance is declared to bring great fruit for śūdras.
The rite should be caused to be performed.
The one-syllabled great mantra grants the fulfillment of all desires.
The threefold form especially awakens knowledge of all scriptures.
